description: Pierce County, Washington publishes this geospatial resource. Coverage is the county or the specific subarea named below. GPS-surveyed Foothills Trail sections carry surface, maintenance, crossing and improvement attributes. The native layer exposes polyline geometry and named attributes, including SURFACE, MAINTENANC, COMMENTS, GPS_DATE, LABEL, CROSSING. It provides source-defined infrastructure geometry, constraints or measurements for capacity planning studies. This trail-specific maintenance inventory is distinct from the countywide constructed-trails geometry; dates and condition fields require interpretation. The public county catalogue advertises ArcGIS REST access and export descriptors such as GeoJSON, CSV and shapefile. Public metadata access was verified; no feature query or file download was performed. Reuse is subject to county terms linked by the provider; the PDF terms were not read, so no open licence or unrestricted reuse is assumed. Charges are not stated. Metadata modification dates do not establish observation dates, and a regular update schedule is not stated. No directly related active record was confirmed for this resource.
